items.description: Demonstrated fabrication of computational or experimental evidence, including copied reference answers falsely presented as independent results, invalidates the submission.

Demonstrated unauthorized access to hidden evaluator answers invalidates the submission. Local failed calculations, wrong physical assignments or incomplete conclusions affect only their dependent scientific items.

local_failure_policy: Each final scientific item is pass/fail. Missing, incorrect or insufficient evidence fails only the affected item; independent supported points are retained. There is no need_review outcome.
